summary: Very low engagement and zero DMs; Instagram bio mentions niche, price and free site check, which conflicts with brand rules.
guidance:
- High skip rates (≈70%) show the first 3 seconds need a stronger hook; start with a bold question or contrast.
- Rotate hook styles (question, contrast, story, myth‑bust) instead of reusing the same style repeatedly.
- Topics that repeat (e.g., “same 5 questions”) should be varied; try “What if your customers could get answers instantly?”
- Keep captions developer‑focused, showing real work, not ad‑like language.
- Use national hashtags only (#FreelanceIndia #Freelancers #LeadGeneration #GetClients #SmallBusinessIndia).
- Keep reels under 30 s, aim for avg watch >10 s, and add a clear CTA to DM for a quick advice chat.

instructions.research: Identify 2‑3 common customer queries that small businesses across India (e.g., cafes, gyms, clinics) receive daily.
instructions.analysis: Select one query and outline how an AI chatbot can answer it, noting the ease it brings to the business.
instructions.writer: Write a 40‑word post using a question hook, mention "pay after approval", invite DMs for a quick fit check, and include an "Example" conversation labeled as such.
instructions.image: Create a simple graphic showing a chat bubble exchange (text only) illustrating the example conversation.
instructions.video: Film a 15‑second text‑overlay video: first 3 seconds show a bold question, next 10 seconds summarize the chatbot benefit, end with "DM for a quick chat".

manual_tips: Update the Instagram bio to remove niche, price and free‑check claims; keep it generic per brand rules.
Leave thoughtful comments on 5 recent posts from Indian small‑business pages using relevant hashtags to attract attention.
Reply to any likes or comments on recent reels with a personal thank‑you and a brief prompt to DM for more info.
